localEquivalent.note: Upstream 9router 9dbdca0e5e folded the zai-search registry entry into glm.searchConfig (same URL, apikey/bearer, costPerQuery 0, web, 5/50 results, 10s, 5min cache). Its wire is a single stateless JSON-RPC tools/call with an extra `count` argument and no MCP handshake; this staging unit carries the source MCP session contract.

exports.index.js: public staging exports (config.js, adapter.js except invalid, service.js)

auth.identity: selected connection only; a fresh MCP session per call; no session, credential or result cache across connections; no refresh, replay or failover

envelope.transport: MCP Streamable HTTP: POST initialize (id 0) -> POST notifications/initialized (202) -> POST tools/call (id 1); Accept: application/json, text/event-stream; mcp-session-id and negotiated mcp-protocol-version on later posts
envelope.request: tools/call { name: 'web_search_prime', arguments: { search_query, search_domain_filter?: includes.join(',') } }
envelope.response: result.content[type=text].text joined by newline; JSON array of { title, link, content, publish_date, icon, media } or a JSON string encoding that array; sliced to max_results; total_results_available = valid item count

integration.search: open-sse/handlers/search/index.js handleSearchCore: for provider 'glm' (and a future 'zai-search' alias) call handleZaiSearchNative({ body: normalizedBody, credentials, signal, providerId: provider.id }) instead of tryDedicatedProvider/buildGlmSearchRequest; on success call onRequestSuccess and return the result unchanged
integration.route: src/sse/handlers/search.js: pass request.signal through to handleSearchCore; acceptedJob on a failed result must be recorded like other media accepted jobs and must not trigger account fallback replay
integration.provider: existing open-sse/providers/registry/glm.js already has serviceKinds ['llm','webSearch'] and the identical searchConfig; registration only needs the dispatch switch. A 'zai' connection fallback (source SEARCH_CREDENTIAL_FALLBACKS) needs a credential-fallback hook in the search route; none exists locally today
integration.catalog: docs/providers/catalog.mdx and shared catalogs updated at serial registration only

restrictions: unregistered pending serial registration after four additions
web search_type only; max_results 1..50 (clamped to 50, default 5) applied locally because the tool takes no count
include domain hosts only (up to 20); excluded domains, offset, country, language, time_range, content_options and provider_options are refused before any network call
fixed origin https://api.z.ai; caller or connection base URL overrides are not honored; redirects refused
10s per-step (default) and 15s total (default) deadlines, both capped at 60s; 2MiB success and 16KiB error bounds
no GET SSE listener, session DELETE, resumption or server-initiated requests; only the matching JSON-RPC response is read
upstream error messages and bodies are never relayed; tool errors and malformed text are failures (the source returns empty results)
cost stays unknown in accounting; wire usage mirrors source search_cost_usd 0
no dynamic model discovery: the source has none for search providers
